title: Flowable's automatic history cleanup is disabled by default
content:
The documentation states that *"Automatic cleanup of HistoricProcessInstances is disabled by default"*, and that when enabled *"the default is to run a cleanup job at 1 AM to delete all HistoricProcessInstances and associated data that have ended 365 days prior or older"*.

This corrects a claim held earlier in this vault. Flowable's history is deletable — six documented `HistoryService` methods plus raw SQL deletes — but it is not deleted on its own. Purging is a deliberate administrative act, not drift.

The distinction matters when the argument is put to someone who runs the product. "Your history will quietly disappear" is refutable in one sentence; "your history is mutable and erasable, and nothing detects either" is not.
description: Default retention is effectively infinite; the 365-day cleanup job runs only once an administrator enables it, so calling the history purgeable overstates the shipped posture.
